name: Krrish
summary: Bollywood's masked speedster: Krishna Mehra, born with the powers an alien gave his father Rohit. Played by Hrithik Roshan in Krrish (2006) and Krrish 3 (2013).
origin: In Koi... Mil Gaya (2003), the stranded alien Jadoo gave Rohit Mehra a brilliant mind and peak physical abilities. Rohit's son Krishna is born with those gifts, and his grandmother Sonia raises him in a remote hill village, making him promise to keep them secret. Krishna follows Priya to Singapore. When a circus tent catches fire, he hides his face behind a black mask and an inside-out jacket to save the trapped children, and the press calls the masked rescuer Krrish. He then learns his father is alive, held prisoner by Dr. Siddhant Arya.
powers: Genius-level intelligence inherited from his father
His blood gave his father the base for an antidote to Kaal's virus

storyline.title: Koi... Mil Gaya
storyline.beat: Rohit Mehra befriends the alien Jadoo, who unlocks his potential. This sets up the powers Krishna will inherit.

storyline.title: The masked rescuer
storyline.beat: Grown up and hiding his gifts, Krishna follows Priya to Singapore and invents the Krrish disguise to save children from a burning circus.

storyline.title: Saving his father
storyline.beat: Krishna tracks Dr. Siddhant Arya to his island, rescues the captive Rohit and fatally wounds Arya.

storyline.title: Kaal's virus
storyline.beat: Now married to Priya, Krishna faces the telekinetic geneticist Kaal, whose virus spreads through Mumbai. Rohit builds an antidote from Krishna's blood.

storyline.title: Brothers in blood
storyline.beat: Kaal turns out to be Rohit's son too. Kaal seems to kill Krrish, but Rohit gives his life to revive him with a solar device, and Krrish destroys Kaal.

storyline.title: Kid Krrish
storyline.beat: Cartoon Network India airs four Kid Krrish animated films, starting in 2013.

storyline.title: Krrish 4
storyline.beat: Rakesh Roshan announces that Hrithik Roshan will make his directing debut with Krrish 4.

gossip.text: Krrish was the first Indian film shot under Singapore's Film-in-Singapore subsidy scheme, and over 60% of it was filmed there.
Rakesh Roshan hired Hollywood effects experts Marc Kolbe and Craig Mumma (Independence Day) and Hong Kong action director Tony Ching.
Krrish 3 is only the second Krrish film. The title counts Koi... Mil Gaya as part one.

gossip.truth: It was planned as a 3D film but released only in 2D because there wasn't enough time to convert it.

gossip.text: Hrithik Roshan plays both Krishna and his father Rohit across the films.
Krrish won three Filmfare Awards, including Best Special Effects.

quiz.q: Who gave Krrish's father Rohit his powers?
quiz.why: In Koi... Mil Gaya, the alien Jadoo unlocks Rohit's abilities, which Krishna later inherits.

quiz.q: Where was most of Krrish (2006) filmed?
quiz.why: Over 60% of the film was shot in Singapore.

quiz.q: What was Krrish's very first disguise?
options: A black mask and an inside-out jacket
quiz.why: He threw it together on the spot to save children at a burning circus.

quiz.q: What does the alien's name Jadoo mean?
quiz.why: In the franchise, Jadoo is a Hindi word for magic.

quiz.q: Where does the name Krrish come from?
quiz.why: Krishna stops partway through saying his name, and the fragment sticks.

theme.tagline: Mask on, jacket inside out, city saved before chai.

timeline.title: Krrish hits cinemas
timeline.note: Hrithik Roshan's masked hero opens on 23 June 2006, carrying the powers handed down from his father's alien friend.

timeline.title: Krrish 3
timeline.note: The Diwali sequel sets him against Kaal and earns close to ₹400 crore worldwide.

timeline.title: Kid Krrish
timeline.note: Cartoon Network India airs a kid-sized animated Krrish, the first of four TV films through 2015.

timeline.title: Krrish 4 announced
timeline.note: Rakesh Roshan confirms a fourth film. Its first release target later slides because of the pandemic.

timeline.title: Hrithik takes the director's chair
timeline.note: Rakesh Roshan announces that his son Hrithik will make his directing debut with Krrish 4.

timeline.title: Krrish 4 gets a plan
timeline.note: In September 2025 Rakesh Roshan says the story and budget are locked, with filming planned from mid-2026 for a 2027 release.

timeline.title: Filming slips to late 2026
timeline.note: The Krrish franchise page records Rakesh Roshan saying in June 2026 that filming of Krrish 4 will most likely start at the end of 2026.

facts.text: The first Krrish needed over 1,200 visual-effects shots, covering about 90 minutes of screen time, made by a team of more than 100 specialists in India with two Hollywood experts.
Offered a reward after saving children from a circus fire, Krishna asks his friend Kristian Li to pose as Krrish so that Kristian can pay for his sister's operation.
Rohit's powers came from sunlight, which is why the solar device he builds in Krrish 3 can bring Krishna back to life.
In Krrish 3, Krishna keeps getting fired from regular jobs because he is busy moonlighting as a superhero.
Krishna's blood becomes the antidote to Kaal's virus, and he spreads it across Mumbai, so the hero's own body saves the city.
During a flying stunt on Krrish, a wire snapped and Hrithik Roshan fell about 50 feet onto a shop canopy and survived. He called it a freak accident and said the only word for it was jadoo.
Krishna and Priya name their newborn son Rohit Mehra, and the baby seems to show superpowers at the end of Krrish 3.
In Krrish 3, Hrithik reportedly wore wax masks that melted in the Indian heat, up to 44 degrees, and went through about 500 of them.
A week after Krrish opened, Superman Returns arrived in India, and Krrish still did better at the Indian box office.
Hrithik Roshan got hurt a lot making Krrish: he tore a hamstring in the circus scene, singed his hair running through fire, and broke a thumb and a toe training for the wirework.
Krrish 3 is the highest-grossing Indian superhero film, at about 393 crore rupees worldwide on a budget of around 100 crore, according to its Wikipedia page.
At the end of Krrish (2006), Rohit uses the supercomputer to send signals to space, hoping to reach Jadoo, and the family sees a spaceship in the night sky.
In September 2016 Rakesh Roshan said a tweet showing Lord Ganesha as Krrish inspired him to announce a fourth film.

The name Krrish began as a slip. While rescuing a circus boy, Krishna starts to give his name, remembers his promise to keep his powers secret and stops short, and the boy repeats the fragment to everyone.
Hrithik Roshan chose the title. He wanted a superhero name that was easy to say, sounded fantastical and could carry over into later films, and he built it from Krishna.
Krrish was screened in the Informative Screening category of the 2014 Pyongyang International Film Festival in North Korea.
Krrish: Menace of the Monkey Men, a 2013 comic by Tom DeFalco and Sal Buscema, also became an animated mobile comic released in weekly chapters through a Krrish Comics app.
J Bole Toh Jadoo, a 2004 Nickelodeon India spin-off about the alien Jadoo and two kids, was among the first 3D live-action and animation shows made in India.
Dr. Siddhant Arya's supercomputer shows the future, but it only works with Rohit's heartbeat and retina scans, so Arya keeps Rohit in a coma while he rebuilds it.
Arya checks the machine and sees a vision of Krrish killing him. He consults it again later and the predicted future has not changed.
Krrish is considered Indian cinema's first superhero film series, running over three films from 2003 to 2013.
The mask comes from a black clown's mask Krishna wears at the circus fire, paired with an inside-out jacket, and that disguise makes him the mysterious hero Krrish.
Kid Krrish, the animated film series made for ages 8 to 12, first aired on 2 October 2013 on Cartoon Network India in Hindi, English, Tamil and Telugu.
Krrish was one of the first Indian productions to use large-scale CGI and wire stunts at an international standard, and it was the highest-grossing Indian superhero film when it came out.

kidSummary: Krishna Mehra is a kind young man with super speed, strength and a brilliant mind, powers his father got from the alien Jadoo. He keeps them secret until a circus fire forces him to act, and the masked hero is soon known as Krrish.

story.title: A father's gift
story.text: An alien called Jadoo gives Krishna's father special powers, and Krishna is born with them too.

story.title: A promise to Grandma
story.text: Krishna grows up in the hills and promises his grandmother to keep his powers secret.

story.title: The circus rescue
story.text: When a circus tent catches fire in Singapore, he puts on a black mask and jacket to save the children.

story.title: Saving his father
story.text: Krishna finds out his father is alive and rescues him from the villain Dr. Arya.

story.title: Brother against brother
story.text: In Krrish 3 he faces Kaal, and learns that the villain is his father's other son.
